# MXPACKPRO

MXPACKPRO is the international website of Foshan Xumelo Technology Co., Ltd., a custom food packaging supplier based in Foshan, China.

## Core pages
- https://mxpackpro.com/products — food packaging product categories
- https://mxpackpro.com/custom-packaging — custom structure, printing and sampling process
- https://mxpackpro.com/solutions — packaging by food business type
- https://mxpackpro.com/resources — packaging buying guides
- https://mxpackpro.com/about-us — company and project support
- https://mxpackpro.com/faq — MOQ, artwork, materials, samples and production answers
- https://mxpackpro.com/get-a-quote — contact and quotation request
